comparison.objective: Open a push-and-turn child-resistant bottle cap; candidate calibrates and locks an adjustable gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Both combine rotation with constraint and may use bimanual stabilization, but the cap requires axial pressing and unscrewing rather than driver/wrench countertorque on coupled screw-and-nut hardware.
comparison.success_condition: Requires cap removal or loosening without tipping or spilling; candidate requires a retained 90° stop through three close-open cycles with limited drift and both nuts retained.
comparison.reason: The record tests release of an interlocked closure, while the candidate tests precise adjustment preservation during locking and subsequent functional cycling.
